This draft cannot yet accept an outside-app deletion request. A monitored mailbox and verified manual process are required before publication or use as the Play Console deletion URL.

Delete Your Account in the App

You can request permanent deletion of your Cubyfit account and supported associated personal records. This action cannot be undone.

  1. Sign in to Cubyfit.
  2. Go to Account → Data & Privacy → Delete Account.
  3. Read the warning and enter DELETE-ACCOUNT.
  4. Complete Clerk identity reverification with the required email code.
  5. Submit the deletion request.

The app displays available progress information while the deletion service works. Completion may take time or require retries.

Cannot Access Your Account?

An outside-app request channel is being established. [VERIFIED ACCOUNT DELETION EMAIL PENDING] must be a monitored, working address before this page can be published as an external request pathway.

When available, email that address with the subject Cubyfit Account Deletion Request, identify the email associated with your Cubyfit account, and clearly request permanent deletion. We may require secure proof of ownership. Never email a password, authentication code or session token. You should not need to reinstall the app to initiate an outside-app request.

Before publication: Assign an owner, implement a secure authorized manual workflow, and verify the mailbox and a seven-calendar-day acknowledgement target. No response time is promised by this unpublished draft.

What the Process Deletes

The verified deletion job removes supported account-owned active Convex records: profile; habits and historical completions; missions and completions; custom exercises; routines; workouts, nested exercises and sets; weights; measurements; rest days; favorites; preferences; and synchronization records and operations. These cover supported cloud-backed fitness, nutrition and account-linked progress records.

The job then requests deletion of the matching RevenueCat customer and Clerk identity. If a customer has another nonanonymous alias, processing pauses for review instead of deleting an ambiguous customer. The device that observes completion removes the matching account-specific SQLite file and reminders.

Cubyfit does not intend to retain identifiable fitness statistics solely for business analytics after account deletion. No separate account-linked business-analytics warehouse was identified in the reviewed source.

What May Remain

  • A limited technical deletion-status record for about 30 days after completion; incomplete jobs remain for retries and review.
  • Account data on disconnected devices until they reconnect and process completion. If the status record has expired by then, manual app-data clearing may be needed.
  • Operating-system and provider backups under separate schedules.
  • Store billing and transaction records, and provider-held security, diagnostic, advertising or infrastructure records under their applicable policies and obligations.
  • Guest data and shared downloaded catalog files, which are separate from authenticated account records.

The current job has no direct purge for Sentry events, AdMob records, Cloudflare gateway state or app-store transactions. We cannot promise immediate erasure from every system.

Cancel Your Subscription Separately

Account deletion does not automatically cancel billing. To stop future renewals, manage the subscription with Google Play or Apple.
